sources.title: Prompting Whisper for QA-driven Zero-shot End-to-end Spoken
sources.snippet: This paper proposes the use of Whisper, a standalone speech processing model, for zero-shot end-to-end (E2E) SLU. To handle unseen semantic labels, SLU tasks are integrated into a question-answering (QA) framework, which prompts the Whisper decoder for semantics deduction.

sources.title: Introducing Whisper - OpenAI
sources.snippet: We've trained and are open-sourcing a neural net called Whisper that approaches human level robustness and accuracy on English speech recognition.
